title: Do Models Explain Themselves? Counterfactual Simulatability of Natural Language Explanations

layout.note: A top-down chat transcript (user question on the left, AI answer and a wide explanation card on the right and centre) forks through two thin black arrows into two lower columns: the user's expected exchange inside a pink thought bubble on the left and the AI's actual exchange on the right. A red curved double-headed arrow links the two answers; a takeaway sentence and a user icon sit at the bottom.

lesson: Stage the failure as a chat that forks into an 'expected' lane (in a thought bubble) and an 'actual' lane, tie the two answers with a red double-headed arrow carrying one verdict word, and reuse the actor colours in the heading words.
